nodes.description: Mapping of token holder address to token balance, mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved allowance, mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Address of the contract owner, set in Owned constructor and updated by acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Total token supply set in the ZEXCoin constructor and read by totalSupply().
SafeMath addition with overflow check via require(c >= a).
SafeMath subtraction with underflow check via require(b <= a).
SafeMath multiplication with overflow check require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath division with zero-divisor check require(b > 0).
Owned constructor that assigns msg.sender as the contract owner.
Only-owner function that stages a new owner into newOwner.
Two-step ownership acceptance; caller must equal newOwner, then owner is reassigned.
Token constructor that mints the whole supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus the balance of address(0).
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer; debits msg.sender and credits the recipient using SafeMath.
ERC20 approve; sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to tokens without zeroing first.
ERC20 transferFrom; debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits the recipient.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then performs an external call into the spender contract via receiveApproval.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
Only-owner rescue function performing an external call to an arbitrary ERC20 at tokenAddress.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, balance holder and allowance spender.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) with attacker-controlled target.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary token contract.
Balance subtraction/addition inside transfer processed through SafeMath helpers.
Balance and allowance subtraction/addition inside transferFrom processed through SafeMath helpers.
First addend parameter a of safeAdd.
Second addend parameter b of safeAdd.
Return local c holding the sum a + b in safeAdd.
Minuend parameter a of safeSub.
Subtrahend parameter b of safeSub.
Return local c holding a - b in safeSub.
First factor parameter a of safeMul.
Second factor parameter b of safeMul.
Return local c holding a * b in safeMul.
Dividend parameter a of safeDiv.
Divisor parameter b of safeDiv.
Return local c holding a / b in safeDiv.
Address parameter _newOwner stored into newOwner by transferOwnership.
Address parameter tokenOwner whose balance is read.
Named return local balance of balanceOf.
Recipient parameter to of transfer.
Amount parameter tokens of transfer, used in balance arithmetic.
Spender parameter of approve used as allowance key.
Amount parameter tokens of approve written into allowed.
Source account parameter from of transferFrom.
Recipient parameter to of transferFrom.
Amount parameter tokens of transferFrom, used in balance and allowance arithmetic.
Owner key parameter tokenOwner of allowance.
Spender key parameter of allowance.
Spender parameter of approveAndCall that becomes the external call target.

Arbitrary bytes parameter data forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Arbitrary token contract address parameter tokenAddress used as external call target.
Amount parameter tokens passed to the external ERC20 transfer call.

edges.reason: Parameter a is summed into the return local c inside safeAdd.
Parameter b is summed into the return local c inside safeAdd.
Parameter a flows into return local c inside safeSub.
Parameter b flows into return local c inside safeSub.
Parameter a flows into return local c inside safeMul.
Parameter b flows into return local c inside safeMul.
Parameter a flows into return local c inside safeDiv.
Parameter b flows into return local c inside safeDiv.
msg.sender is written into the owner state variable by the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before allowing transferOwnership.
Owned constructor assigns the caller-controlled address into owner.
transfer uses msg.sender as the address whose balance is debited.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key of allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall forwards msg.sender into the external receiveApproval callback.
Recipient parameter to is credited inside transfer.
Amount parameter tokens drives the balance updates in transfer.
User-supplied tokens feeds the balance arithmetic operation in transfer.
Source parameter from selects the debited balance in transferFrom.
Recipient parameter to is credited inside transferFrom.
Amount parameter tokens drives both balance and allowance updates in transferFrom.
User-supplied tokens feeds the balance and allowance arithmetic in transferFrom.
Spender parameter is written as the allowance key in approve.
Tokens parameter is written as the allowance value in approve.
Spender parameter keys the allowance mapping in approveAndCall.
Tokens parameter is written into allowed in approveAndCall.
Caller-supplied data bytes are passed through approveAndCall.
Untrusted spender address is the target of the external receiveApproval call.
Arbitrary data bytes are forwarded to the external callback.
tokenAddress parameter is the target contract of the external ERC20 transfer call.
tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call.
Parameter _newOwner is stored into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership reassigns the owner state variable after checking msg.sender == newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears the newOwner state variable to address(0).
newOwner is the required caller identity for acceptOwnership.
transfer writes updated balances into the balances mapping.
approve writes the granted amount into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom writes updated balances into the balances mapping.
transferFrom decreases the spender allowance in the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the granted amount into the allowed mapping.
Constructor mints the full supply into balances of the fixed address.
Constructor assigns the fixed total supply into _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] when computing the circulating supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the given owner.
tokenOwner parameter selects the mapping entry read by balanceOf.
Named return local balance carries the result out of balanceOf.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
tokenOwner parameter keys the allowance lookup.
spender parameter keys the allowance lookup.
approveAndCall performs an external callback into the spender contract after updating state.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract.
Cross-contract transfer in the rescue function sends tokens to the owner state variable.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transfer executes balance arithmetic guarded by the SafeMath helpers.
transferFrom executes balance and allowance arithmetic guarded by SafeMath.
Any caller can invoke the payable fallback function, which then reverts.
onlyOwner on transferAnyERC20Token compares msg.sender against owner.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a of safeAdd is a transient input of the safeAdd core function and carries no standalone identity.
Parameter b of safeAdd is a transient input of the safeAdd core function.
Local c of safeAdd only holds the intermediate sum returned by the safeAdd function.
Parameter a of safeSub is a transient input of the safeSub core function.
Parameter b of safeSub is a transient input of the safeSub core function.
Local c of safeSub only holds the intermediate difference returned by safeSub.
Parameter a of safeMul is a transient input of the safeMul core function.
Parameter b of safeMul is a transient input of the safeMul core function.
Local c of safeMul only holds the intermediate product returned by safeMul.
Parameter a of safeDiv is a transient input of the safeDiv core function.
Parameter b of safeDiv is a transient input of the safeDiv core function.
Local c of safeDiv only holds the intermediate quotient returned by safeDiv.
Ownership parameter _newOwner is consumed immediately by transferOwnership to set newOwner.
tokenOwner is only used as the lookup key inside balanceOf.
Named return local balance is just the output slot of balanceOf.
Recipient parameter to is only consumed by transfer when crediting balances.
tokens parameter is the direct input of the balance arithmetic operation inside transfer.
spender parameter is only used as the allowance key inside approve.
tokens parameter is only written into the allowed mapping by approve.
from parameter is the debited account selected by transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited account selected by transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the direct input of the balance and allowance arithmetic in transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter is only used as an allowance lookup key.
spender parameter is only used as an allowance lookup key.
spender parameter becomes the attacker-controlled target of the external receiveApproval call.
tokens parameter is only written into the allowed mapping by approveAndCall.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval callback.
tokenAddress parameter is the target contract of the arbitrary external ERC20 transfer call.
tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call.
